blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.
blocks.zh: 可穿戴的增强现实(AR)助理正在走向持续的现实世界互动,他们通过第一人称视频和音频来感知用户的活动,并在没有明确要求的情况下及时提供口头指导. 虽然主动的视频助理,口语对话系统,以及以自我为中心的任务理解,每个系统都迅速进步,但现有的系统并没有解决决定何时说话和从连续的第一人称流中说什么的共同问题. 我们介绍了EgoVoice,这是一个培训和评估主动自我中心语言助理的框架。 从HoloAssist真实的人类教官的视频录音中,我们通过源头分离和语音合成来构建干净的音频流,并将每段视频会话转换成一种格式,模型必须在每一时刻决定是保持沉默还是提供口头指导. 我们用我们的数据微调一个全方位LLM,并进一步改进它的主动干预行为,直接优化偏好。 跨越封闭式和开源式模型的实验表明,现有的系统很少产生时机成熟,有意义的主动干预,而EgoVoice则在干预时间,内容相关性,以及人类偏好于零镜头主干线方面产生明显的改善.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: As wearable devices such as smart glasses become more capable, augmented reality (AR) assistants are emerging as a practical interface for hands-free interaction. Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses combine voice interaction with first-person visual context, and research prototypes like Google Project Astra explore richer multimodal reasoning from egocentric camera feeds. The long-term vision goes further: an always-on assistant that perceives the user’s ongoing activity through first-person (egocentric) video and audio, and provides spoken guidance at the right moment without being explicitly asked.
blocks.zh: 随着智能眼镜等可穿戴设备能力提高,增强现实(AR)助理正在成为无手互动的实用界面. Meta Ray-Ban智能眼镜将语音互动与第一人称视觉上下文相结合,而Google Project Astra等研究原型则从以自我为中心的相机种子中探索更丰富的多模式推理. 长远的愿景更进一步:一个时刻不停的助手,通过第一人称(egocent)视频和音频来感知用户正在进行的活动,并在适当的时候提供口语指导,而无需明确询问.

blocks.en: Despite growing interest in this direction, most voice interaction systems are designed and evaluated as reactive assistants. The user explicitly asks a question or gives a command, and the model generates a spoken or textual response Long et al. (2026) ; Xie and Wu (2024b) ; Zeng et al. (2024) . In practice, however, real-world assistance often requires help before the user asks for it. During procedural tasks such as assembling furniture or following a recipe, users may be occupied, uncertain, or unaware that they need guidance. A user may not know that a mistake is about to occur or may be unable to pause and ask for help. This motivates proactive egocentric spoken assistance , where an assistant observes a first-person video and audio stream and decides whether to speak, when to speak, and what to say.
blocks.zh: 尽管对这个方向的兴趣越来越大,但大多数语音交互系统都是作为反应助手来设计和评价的. 用户明确提问或给出命令,模型生成口语或文字响应Long等 (2026).;谢和吴 (2024b);曾等 (2024). 然而,实际上,在用户提出要求之前,现实世界的援助往往需要帮助。 在诸如装配家具或遵循食谱等程序性任务中,用户可能会被占用、不确定或不知道需要指导。 用户可能不知道一个错误即将发生,或可能无法停下来求救. 这激发了主动自负主义的口语协助,

blocks.en: Building such an assistant requires three capabilities that have so far been studied separately: multimodal perception with speech output, simultaneous listening and speaking, and proactive intervention from streaming egocentric video. Recent multimodal models can process video, audio, and text while generating spoken responses in real-time Fu et al. (2026) ; OpenAI (2024) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Cui et al. (2026) . Full-duplex spoken dialog systems allow models to listen and speak simultaneously without explicit turn boundaries Défossez et al. (2024) ; Roy et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. (2025a) ; Yu et al. (2026) . Proactive video assistants can decide when and what guidance to offer from streaming egocentric video, though they produce text rather than speech Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Wang et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Qian et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2026) . However, to the best of our knowledge, no existing work combines these three capabilities to train a single model for proactive spoken guidance from continuous egocentric streams.
blocks.zh: 建立这样一个助理需要三种能力,迄今为止已经单独研究过:用语音输出的多模式感知,同时听和说话,以及从流出以自我为中心的视频进行主动干预。 近期多模式模式可以处理视频,音频,文本,同时在实时Fu等(2026)中生成口语响应;OpenAI (2024);徐等(2025);Cui等(2026). 完全繁复的口语对话系统允许模型同时听和说话,而不明确转弯边界Défossez等人(2024);Roy等人(2026);Wang等人(2025a); 于等 (2026) (中文(简体) ). 积极主动的视频助理可以决定从流出以自我为中心的视频中提供何时和何种指导,尽管他们制作的是文本而不是张作霖等人的演讲(2025年c; 王等 (2026年); 陈等 (2024年); Q等 (2025年); 张等 (2026年). 然而,据我们所知,目前没有一项工作将这三项能力结合起来,以培训一个单一的模式,从不断的以自我为中心的流派中提供主动的口头指导。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. We start from HoloAssist Wang et al. (2023) , a corpus of egocentric task assistance with real human instructors, and process its recordings into clean, time-aligned streaming supervision through source separation and speech resynthesis. We then perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on MiniCPM-o 4.5 Cui et al. (2026) , an open-source full-duplex multimodal LLM, to learn when and what to say from continuous egocentric video and audio streams, and further refine intervention timing and frequency through direct preference optimization (DPO) Rafailov et al. (2023) . We evaluate models along three axes: whether they intervene at the right time, whether the content is relevant, and whether the overall assistance is helpful as judged by a large language model (LLM) and by human evaluators.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了EgoVoice,这是培训和评估主动自我中心语言助理的框架。 我们从HoloAssist Wang等人(2023年)开始,这是一套以自我为中心的任务辅助工具,由真正的人类教官协助,通过源头分离和语音合成,将录音处理成干净、有时间相通的流体监督。 然后,我们对MiniCPM-o 4.5 Cui等人(2026年)进行有监督的微调(SFT),这是一种开放源码的全双式多式LLM,从不断以自我为中心的视频和音频流中学习时间和话语,并通过直接优惠优化(DPO)Rafailov等人(2023年)来进一步完善干预时间和频率。 我们沿着三个轴线评价模型:它们是否在适当的时候干预,内容是否相关,以及整体援助是否如大型语言模型(LLM)和人类评价者判断的那样有用.

blocks.en: Through experiments across closed-source, open-source, and our own trained models, we show that existing multimodal systems rarely produce well-timed proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields improvements over all baselines on timing and content relevance, with complementary strengths between the SFT and DPO variants. Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 通过跨越封闭源代码、开放源代码和我们自己训练有素的模式的实验,我们显示,现有的多式联运系统很少产生及时的主动干预,而 " EgoVoice " 在时间和内容相关性方面对所有基线都有改进,在SFT和DPO的变体之间具有互补优势。 我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en: • We construct a dataset and benchmark for proactive egocentric spoken assistance from HoloAssist recordings, producing clean training data with time-aligned intervention labels and spoken guidance targets. • We train EgoVoice-SFT and EgoVoice-DPO, and show that the two stages are complementary: SFT retains an edge in content relevance while DPO refines intervention timing. • We establish an evaluation protocol covering intervention timing, content relevance, and overall assistance quality for spoken assistant scenarios, and provide a comprehensive comparison across baselines and our models.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Spoken Dialog and Omni-Modal Models. Early voice interaction systems relied on cascaded pipelines of automatic speech recognition (ASR), language modeling, and text-to-speech (TTS) Lin et al. (2024) . Subsequent work showed that LLMs can directly generate discrete speech tokens Long et al. (2026) ; Xie and Wu (2024b) ; Zeng et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2023) ; Kim et al. (2024) ; Fang et al. (2025b) . This line has rapidly scaled to omni-modal models that accept interleaved visual data, audio, and text while producing both text and speech in a streaming manner Fu et al. (2026) ; OpenAI (2024) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Cui et al. (2026) ; Xie and Wu (2024a) ; Zhong et al. (2025) .

blocks.en: Egocentric Task Understanding and Datasets. Large-scale egocentric video datasets have enabled research on activity understanding from a first-person perspective. Ego4D Grauman et al. (2022) established benchmarks for episodic memory, forecasting, and social interaction, and EPIC-KITCHENS Damen et al. (2018) provided densely annotated cooking sessions for action recognition and anticipation. HoloAssist Wang et al. (2023) captured instructor-guided task assistance sessions with synchronized egocentric video and audio, including annotations for intervention type prediction. Together with Assembly101 Sener et al. (2022) and Ego-Exo4D Grauman et al. (2024) , these datasets have advanced procedure understanding, but none targets continuous spoken guidance during ongoing tasks. Among these, HoloAssist is closest to our setting as it contains real instructor speech, though its audio is recorded as a mono channel with pitch-shifted speaker identities, requiring additional processing before being used for voice interaction training.

blocks.en: Proactive Assistance in Streaming Video. Proactive assistance has been studied broadly in dialog systems, where models anticipate user needs and initiate responses without explicit prompts Deng et al. (2023) ; Wu et al. (2019) . This idea has been extended to streaming video LLMs, which introduce per-frame speak-or-stay-silent decisions Chen et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025b) and improve timing through reinforcement learning, specialized objectives, or modular architectures Wang et al. (2026) ; Qian et al. (2025) ; Lu et al. (2026) ; Yan et al. (2026) .

(2025c) proposed a data curation pipeline, evaluation protocols, and an end-to-end streaming model for proactive dialog from video, and ESTP Zhang et al. Prior work has shown that LLMs can generate appropriate content but struggle with the timing of spoken responses Umair et al. (2024) , and EgoSpeak Kim et al. blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: EgoVoice converts egocentric instructional recordings into a format suitable for proactive spoken assistants. Building upon MiniCPM-o 4.5 Cui et al. (2026) , a streaming full-duplex multimodal model, we adapt its listen-or-speak interface to egocentric task assistance through supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization. We first describe how we construct the dataset from HoloAssist (Section 3.1 ), then present the evaluation protocol for measuring proactive spoken assistance (Section 3.2 ), and finally the training pipeline that learns and refines intervention behavior (Section 3.3 ). An overview of EgoVoice is in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: EgoVoice将以自我为中心的教学录音转换成适合主动的口语助理的格式. 利用MiniCPM-o 4.5 Cui等人(2026年),我们通过监督的微调和直接优化优惠,调整其听-说接口,使之适应自我中心的任务协助。 我们首先描述我们如何构建HoloAssist的数据集(第3.1节),然后介绍衡量主动口头援助的评价程序(第3.2节),最后介绍学习和完善干预行为的训练程序(第3.3节)。 EgoVoice概况见图2。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据构建

blocks.en: Perhaps the most straightforward approach to building an egocentric proactive spoken assistant would be to start from an existing video-text dataset Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Wang et al. (2025b) and convert the textual instructions into speech. However, this strategy has fundamental limitations as illustrated in Figure 4 . Text-based benchmarks assume that the full instruction is visible to the user at the moment it is issued. Speech, by contrast, takes time to play back. If a synthesized utterance is placed at the same timestamp as the original text instruction, the user will already be acting on the advice before the utterance finishes playing, creating a mismatch between the audio timeline and the user’s behavior. Shifting the synthesis earlier to avoid mismatch is also unreliable, as the user’s actions are continuous and the shifted utterance may collide with other instructions or fall during an unrelated action. Moreover, synthesizing speech from text labels does not account for the ambient sounds that naturally accompany real-world physical tasks.
blocks.zh: 也许建立一个以自我为中心的积极主动的口头助理的最直接的方法是从现有的视频文本数据集开始 张等 (2025年c); 王等 (2025年b)并把正文指示转换为语音. 然而,正如图4所显示的,这项战略有根本的局限性。 以文字为基础的基准假设,整个指令在发布时对用户是可见的. 相比之下,发言需要时间来回弹奏。 如果一个被合成的语音被放置在与原始文本指令相同的时间戳上,那么在语音结束播放之前,用户就已经根据建议行事了,从而造成音频时间表与用户行为不匹配. 更早地转移合成以避免不匹配也是不可靠的,因为用户的行动是连续的,转移后的话语可能会与其他指令相撞,或者在不相干的行动中掉入. 此外,从文本标签中合成语音并不反映自然伴随现实世界物理任务的环境声音.

blocks.en: For these reasons, we start from HoloAssist Wang et al. (2023) , a large-scale corpus of egocentric task assistance in which a user performs physical tasks while receiving spoken guidance from a human instructor. HoloAssist’s spoken interventions are already aligned with the user’s behavior through real-world recording, and preserve background noises. However, the raw recordings are not directly usable for training a multimodal voice interaction model. The video comes with a single audio channel in which user speech, instructor speech, and background sounds are mixed, and speaker identities are anonymized through pitch shifting, which makes them sound unnatural. We therefore process each session as follows.
blocks.zh: 出于这些原因,我们从HoloAssist Wang et al.(2023年)开始,这是一个大规模自负式任务协助工具,用户在接受人教官的口头指导的同时执行物理任务。 HoloAssist的口头发言已经通过真实世界的录制与用户的行为一致, 然而,原始录音无法直接用于培训一种多式语音互动模式。 视频带有一个单一的音频频道,其中用户语音,导师语音,和背景声音混合,演讲者身份通过投出移位被匿名化,这使其听起来不自然. 因此,我们按以下方式处理每届会议。

blocks.en: First, we separate background audio from the mixture. The pitch shifting renders the voices unsuitable for training a natural-sounding voice interaction model, so we isolate only the background sounds. We use SAM-Audio Shi et al. (2025) , a prompt-based source separation model, to extract human voices from the mixture using the speech-containing intervals as prompts and retain the residual as the background channel. We then apply Silero VAD Silero Team (2024) to verify that no residual human speech remains in the separated background, and discard all sessions where voice activity is still detected.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们把背景音频和混合物分开。 投出移位使得声音不适合训练出一种自然发声的声音交互模型,所以我们只隔离出背景声音. 我们使用SAM-Audio Shi等人(2025年),一种即时源分取模型,利用含有语音的间隔来从混合物中取出人的声音作为导出并保留剩余作为背景通道. 然后,我们采用Silero VAD Silero Team(2024)来核实在分离的背景中没有残留的人类言论,并丢弃所有仍然被检测到语音活性的会话.

blocks.en: Second, we synthesize clean user and instructor speech. The original transcripts in the HoloAssist metadata contain spelling errors, inconsistent punctuation, and disfluencies, which we normalize using gpt-5.4-mini OpenAI (2026) . We also remove task-irrelevant opening and closing remarks (9.0% of utterances). We then resynthesize with IndexTTS2 Zhou et al. (2026) , a speaker-adaptive TTS, with per-session reference speakers sampled from the English subset of Multilingual LibriSpeech Pratap et al. (2020) (2,498 training speakers, 340 disjoint evaluation speakers). Each utterance is synthesized multiple times; candidates exceeding the original duration are discarded to preserve timing, and the candidate whose ASR transcription exactly matches the original text, as verified by Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Shi et al. (2026) , is selected. Sessions containing any mispronounced utterance are discarded after manual verification. Further details are provided in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 第二,我们合成干净的用户和教官演讲。 HoloAssist元数据中原始的文字记录包含拼写错误,不一致的平分,和不相干,我们使用gpt-5.4-mini OpenAI(2026年)实现这种平分. 我们还删除与任务无关的开场和闭幕词(占发言的9.0%)。 然后,我们与IndexTTS2 Zhou et al.(2026年)重新合成,这是一个适应演讲者的TTS,每个会次的参考演讲者从多语言LibriSpeech Pratap et al.(2020年)的英语子集中抽取(2 498名培训演讲者,340名脱节评价演讲者). 每句话经过多次合成;超过原定期限的候选人被丢弃,以保留时间,并选取其ASR抄录完全符合由Qune3-ASR-1.7B Shi等人(2026年)核实的原文的候选人. 含有任何错误发音的会话在人工核实后被丢弃. 详情见附录A.1。

blocks.en: Figure 3: The streaming interface of EgoVoice ( R101-2Aug-DSLR ). Each chunk carries one video frame and one second of audio, and the model emits Listen or Speak for each. On Speak chunks the LLM emits text tokens, and the speech-token decoder turns them into S3 speech tokens that are decoded into the waveform the user hears.
blocks.zh: 图3:EgoVoice(R101-2Aug-DSLR.)的流线接口. 每个块都装有1个相机框和1秒钟的音频,模型会发出每个相机的听音或说话. 在 Speak 上块 LLM 释放出文本符号, 而 语音调试解码器将它们转换为 S3 语音符号, 解码为用户听到的波形 。

blocks.en: After this full pipeline, the original HoloAssist corpus of 1,673 instructional sessions (124.8 hours) yields 1,249 training sessions (91.7 hours) and 170 held-out benchmark sessions (12.9 hours). Each processed session contains synchronized egocentric video, resynthesized user speech, resynthesized instructor speech, and separated background audio.
blocks.zh: 在这整个管道完成之后,最初的1 673个教学课程(124.8小时)的全科教学课程共产生1 249个培训课程(91.7小时)和170个举办基准课程(12.9小时)。 每个处理的会话都包含同步自负心视频,再合成用户语音,再合成导师语音,以及分离的背景音频.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: We propose an evaluation protocol for measuring proactive spoken assistance over full egocentric task sessions. Following ProAssist Zhang et al. (2025c) , we provide each model with a system prompt containing the task name and step-by-step recipe, so that models have access to the procedural context when deciding whether and what to speak.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个评价议定书,用以衡量主动口头援助相对于完全以自我为中心的任务会议。 遵循ProAsist Zhang等 (2025c),我们向每个模型提供包含任务名称和分步配方的系统提示,这样模型在决定是否和用什么说话时,就可以进入程序背景.

blocks.en: Onset Timing. We match predicted utterances to reference instructor utterances using the Hungarian algorithm Kuhn (1955) with an asymmetric onset window of − 2.5 -2.5 s (early) to + 1.5 +1.5 s (late), reflecting that early interventions are less disruptive than late ones. A predicted utterance can match a reference only if its onset falls within this window. From the matched pairs, we compute Precision, Recall, and F1 as count-based scores over the number of matched, predicted, and reference utterances. All timing metrics are computed per session and macro-averaged across the 170 benchmark sessions.
blocks.zh: 定时. 我们用匈牙利算法Kuhn(1955年)的参考导师的预测语句与非对称发作窗口-2.5-2.5s(早期)相匹配,取而代之的是+1.5+1.5s(晚期),这反映出早期干预的破坏性小于晚期干预。 预言词只有在其发端在这个窗口内时才能与参考词相匹配. 从匹配的对数中,我们计算精度、回想和F1,作为比匹配、预测和参考语数的计分。 所有时间安排指标均按届会计算,并按170个基准届会的宏观平均值计算。

blocks.en: End-of-Utterance Timing. Onset metrics do not capture whether the model finishes speaking before the user needs to act. We therefore measure end-vs-action, the gap between the start of the user’s next action and the predicted utterance end time. A positive value means the model finished speaking before the user needed to act; a negative value means the model was still talking when the user began the action. Since this metric depends on when an utterance begins and how long it lasts, we also report its decomposition. We define start-vs-action as the gap between the start of the user’s next action and the predicted utterance start time; end-vs-action then equals start-vs-action minus the utterance duration for every matched pair (Appendix A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 终取正时. Onset 度量衡不会在用户需要采取行动之前捕获模型是否完成发言. 因此,我们衡量终端-vs-行动、用户下一个行动的开始与预测的结束时间之间的差距。 一个正值表示该模型在用户需要采取行动之前就已完成了发言;一个负值表示该模型在用户开始行动时仍在说话. 由于这一衡量标准取决于一个言论何时开始和持续多久,因此我们也报告其分解情况。 我们定义启动- vs- 动作为用户下一个动作开始和预测的语句开始时间之间的间隔; 端- vs- 动作然后等于启动- vs- 动作减去每对对应的语句持续时间( 附录 A.4 ) 。

blocks.en: Since end-vs-action is meaningful only when the utterance is a procedural directive that prompts a user action rather than a brief acknowledgement, we define an action-linked evaluation subset. Using gpt-5.5 OpenAI (2026) , we classify each reference utterance as a procedural directive or non-directive and link directives to the user’s nearest subsequent action within T = 5 T{=}5 seconds, yielding 942 of 2,067 reference utterances across 170 benchmark sessions. Unlike the other metrics, end-vs-action is reported only on this action-linked subset.
blocks.zh: 由于结束-vs-行动只有在表述是程序指令,促使用户采取行动而不是简短的确认时才有意义,因此我们界定了一个与行动相关的评价子集。 使用gpt-5.5 OpenAI(2026年),我们将每个参考语归类为程序指令或非指令,并将指令与用户最近的后继行动链接在T=5 T{=}5秒内,在170个基准会话中得出2,067个参考语中的942个. 与其他度量衡不同,端-vs-动作只被报告在这个与动作相关的子集上.

blocks.en: Content Relevance. For each temporally matched pair, we compute cosine similarity between the predicted and reference texts using Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Zhang et al. (2025b) .
blocks.zh: 内容相关性。 对于每对时间匹配的文本,我们使用Qune3-Embedding-0.6B计算预测文本和参考文本的同位素相似性 张等 (2025b).

blocks.en: Overall Assistance Quality. We use an LLM-as-a-judge evaluation following the session-level assessment protocol of ProAssist Zhang et al. (2025c) . We prompt gpt-5.4-mini OpenAI (2026) (reasoning effort=medium) to rate each session on four axes on a 1-to-5 Likert scale: Correctness (whether each utterance is accurate given the reference), Promptness (whether the assistant intervenes at the right moment), Efficiency (whether responses are concise and free of redundancy), and Overall (the overall helpfulness of the assistant’s behavior). The judge receives the full session context, with reference and predicted utterances timestamped. Further details are provided in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 总体援助质量。 根据ProAssist Zhang等人(2025年c)的会后评估协议, 我们鼓励gpt-5.4-mini OpenAI(2026年)(合理努力=中等)在1至5个相似度尺度上按四轴对每场课进行评分:正确性(根据参考标准,每场课词是否准确)、即时性(助理是否在适当时刻干预)、效率(答复是否简明而无冗余)和总体性(助理行为的总体帮助)。 法官得到完整的开庭背景,参考和预测的言论加贴时间戳。 详情见附录A.4。

blocks.en: Evaluating Intended and Delivered Speech. Most multimodal speech models produce both a text response and a spoken response. We therefore evaluate all metrics from two sources: text-llm , the text that the model generates internally (reported in Appendix A.6.1 ), and text-asr , the text obtained by transcribing the model’s spoken output with ASR. The former reflects what the model intended to say; the latter reflects what the user actually hears. For timing, text-llm uses the chunk index at which the model produces the text (described in Section 3.3 ). For text-asr , we first transcribe the generated audio with Qwen3-ASR-1.7B, then obtain word-level alignment using Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B Shi et al. (2026) to determine the precise onset and offset of each utterance.
blocks.zh: 评价意向发言和发言。 大多数多式语音模型都产生文本响应和口语响应. 因此,我们从两个来源评估所有衡量标准:文本-llm,该模型内部生成的文本(在附录A.6.1中报告)和文本-asr,通过将模型的口语输出与ASR相转换而获得的文本。 前者反映了模型的意图;后者反映了用户实际听到的. 在时间方面,text-llm使用模型生成文本的块索引(在第3.3节中描述). 对于文本-asr,我们首先将生成的音频与Quen3-ASR-1.7B进行转录,然后使用Quen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B获得词级对齐. Shi等人(2026年)确定每句话的准确发端和相抵.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训

blocks.en: We train EgoVoice by fine-tuning MiniCPM-o 4.5 Cui et al. (2026) , a streaming full-duplex multimodal model that processes interleaved video and audio chunk by chunk. At each one-second chunk, the model encodes the current video frame and audio segment (background audio and user speech), appends the resulting tokens to a running context, and produces a decision: either a Listen token, indicating that the model should remain silent, or a Speak token, after which the LLM backbone autoregressively generates a text response. For each text token, the corresponding LLM hidden state is passed to a speech-token decoder (0.3B parameters), which produces S3 speech tokens Du et al. (2024) converted to a waveform by a streaming flow-matching decoder Lipman et al. (2023) . Figure 3 shows this process on a benchmark session.
blocks.zh: 我们通过微调MiniCPM-o 4.5 Cui等人(2026年)来训练EgoVoice,这是一种流式的全复式多模式模式,它逐块处理互放视频和音频。 每一秒块,模型会将当前视频帧和音频段(背景音频和用户语音)编码,将由此产生的符号附加到运行上下文上,并产生一个决定:要么是听音符,表示模型应该保持静默,要么是Speak符号,之后LLM主干线会自动生成文本响应. 对于每个文本符,对应的LLM隐藏状态会被传递给一个语音-token解码器(0.3B参数),它会产生S3语音符 Du等. (2024)由流相相相接的解码器Lipman等(2023)转换为波形. 图3以基准会话显示这一进程。

blocks.en: For training, we split each processed session from Section 3.1 into 60-second windows at one-second chunk granularity. Each chunk t t within a window is represented as s t = ( v t , a t , z t , w t , c t ) s_{t}=(v_{t},a_{t},z_{t},w_{t},c_{t}) , where v t v_{t} is the egocentric video frame, a t a_{t} is the input audio containing background audio and user speech, z t ∈ { Listen , Speak } z_{t}\in\{\textsc{Listen},\textsc{Speak}\} is the intervention label, w t w_{t} is the normalized text instruction, and c t c_{t} is the corresponding S3 speech-token sequence (both empty when z t = Listen z_{t}=\textsc{Listen} ). Instructor speech is never included in the model input; it is used exclusively as the target output.
blocks.zh: 在训练方面,我们将每个经处理的会议从第3.1节分成60秒窗口,每分一秒。 窗口内的每个块 t t 表示为 s t = (v t, a t, z t, w t, c t ) (v_{t}, a_{t}, z_{t}, w_{t}, c_{t})  s. ,如果 v t v_{t} 是自负的视频框架, t a_{t} 是包含背景音频和用户语音的输入音频, z t { { 聆听, 说 } z_{t}\in\{\textsc{ listen},\ textsc{ speak} 是干预标签, wt w_{t} 是普通文本指令, ct_{t} 是对应的 S3 语音音序列( z t = list z_{t}=\textsc{ listen} 时均为空) 。 教官的语音从不包含在模型输入中;它完全用作目标输出.

blocks.en: Each instructor utterance is segmented into one-second chunks using word-level timestamps from Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B, distributing the text and speech tokens across the corresponding chunks. For each reference utterance, we construct a 60-second training window centered on that utterance (with slight temporal jitter), so that every window contains at least one intervention event surrounded by listening context. This yields 13,676 training windows per epoch. At evaluation, models process complete sessions without windowing.
blocks.zh: 使用从Qune3-ForcedAligner-0.6B的字级时间戳将每个教官的语句分出为一秒块,在相应的块中分配文字和语音符号. 对于每个参考语句,我们构建一个60秒的训练窗口,以该语句为中心(稍有时间焦躁),这样每个窗口就至少包含一个包含监听背景的干预事件. 这样,每个时代都有13 676个培训窗口。 在评价时,模型会处理完成会话而不设窗口.

blocks.en: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). We first train the model to learn the basic behavior of proactive spoken assistance: remain silent during most chunks, but generate task-relevant spoken guidance when intervention is needed. We apply LoRA Hu et al. (2022) to both the LLM backbone and the speech-token decoder, while keeping the vision encoder, audio encoder, and other adapters frozen. Within each window, the model processes chunks autoregressively, emitting either a Listen token or a Speak token followed by the guidance text in byte-pair encoding (BPE) tokens and the S3 speech-token sequence. The training loss is ℒ SFT = ℒ LM + λ ⋅ ℒ S3 \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SFT}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LM}}+\lambda\cdot\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{S3}} with λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 , where ℒ LM \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LM}} is a single autoregressive cross-entropy over Listen / Speak decisions, BPE text tokens, and end-of-turn markers, and ℒ S3 \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{S3}} is a cross-entropy on the speech-token decoder over S3 speech-token frames for Speak chunks only. Gradients from ℒ S3 \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{S3}} are stopped at the LLM hidden states, so the two losses do not share backward signal through the backbone.
blocks.zh: 监督"精通" (SFT). 我们首先培训该模式,以学习主动口头援助的基本行为:在多数情况下保持沉默,但在需要干预时提供与任务有关的口头指导。 我们把LORA Hu等(2022年)应用到LLM主干线和语音调制解码器上,同时使视觉编码器,音频编码器,以及其他适配器保持被冻结. 在每一个窗口内,模型处理会自动地进行分解,释放出一个听取符或一个Speak符,然后是字节-pair编码符和S3语音键序列中的指导文本。 训练损失为L SFT = LLM + λ L S3\ mathcal{ LQQMathrm{ SFT}}=\mathcal{ L}_{\mathrm{ LM}}+\lambda\cdot\mathcal{ L}_{\mathrm{S3}} = 0.1\lambda=0.1,其中LLM\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ LM}}LMXMXMXM{是单个自旋相向的交叉向上反转转动,BPE文本标志,和L S3\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{S3}} 在S3 Speake-token框上仅为Speakles. LLM隐藏状态停止了LS3\mathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{S3}的梯度,因此两个损失不会通过主干共享后向信号.

blocks.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Supervised fine-tuning provides a strong starting point, but proactive assistance admits multiple acceptable behaviors. We further refine the SFT model with DPO Rafailov et al. (2023) , allowing the model to learn from comparisons between alternative candidate samples under the same streaming context.
blocks.zh: 直接优惠优化(DPO). 监督的微调提供了一个有力的起点,但主动援助承认多种可接受的行为. 我们与DPO Rafailov等人(2023年)进一步完善了SFT模型,使该模型能够从同一流派背景下替代候选样本的比较中学习。

blocks.en: From the SFT model, we generate N = 10 N{=}10 candidate samples per training window, each conditioned on the same visual and audio context. We score each candidate with the F1 defined in Section 3.2 , computed after temporal matching using text-llm . We construct preference pairs by selecting the candidate with the highest F1 as the chosen sample y + y^{+} and randomly sampling the rejected sample y − y^{-} from the bottom three candidates by F1, requiring a minimum F1 gap of 0.10. This yields 5,335 preference pairs from windows across 1,021 training sessions.
blocks.zh: 从SFT模型中,每个训练窗口生成N=10个NQX10候选样本,每个样本都以相同的视觉和音频背景为条件. 我们用第3.2节定义的F1给每个候选人打分。 我们通过选择F1最高的候选人作为选取的样本y + y^{+}来构建首选配对,并按F1从下三名候选人中随机抽取被否决的样本y − y^{-},要求F1的最低空档为0.10. 共有1 021个培训班的窗口提供5 335对优惠。

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare EgoVoice against six baselines spanning three categories. For closed-source APIs, we evaluate Gemini Live ( gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio ) and two snapshots of the OpenAI Realtime API ( gpt-realtime and gpt-realtime-2 ), all of which accept streaming video and audio and produce both text and speech. Since these APIs rely on voice activity detection and rarely respond without active user speech, we remove background audio to prevent false triggering, providing a more favorable evaluation condition.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了EgoVoice 和6个跨3个类别的基线。 对于闭源API,我们评价双子座Live(Gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio)和OpenAI Realtime API(gpt-realtime和gp-realtime-2)的两张快照,这些快照都接受流媒体视频和音频,同时产生文字和语音. 由于这些API依赖于语音活性检测,并且很少在没有主动用户语音的情况下响应,所以我们删除了背景音频以防止虚假触发,提供了更有利的评价条件.

blocks.en: As a reference open-source text baseline, we evaluate ProAssist Zhang et al. (2025c) (8B), the most directly comparable prior work, which uses the HoloAssist data and evaluation protocol but handles text rather than speech. Following the ProAssist protocol, it receives streaming video together with ground-truth transcripts of the user’s speech at their original timestamps, and a neutral opening query (e.g., “help me assemble this lamp”) for sessions in which the user never speaks.
blocks.zh: 作为参考开源文本基线,我们评价ProAssist Zhang等(2025c)(8B),这是最直接可比较的前作,它使用HoloAssist的数据和评价协议,但处理文本而不是语音. 根据ProAssist协议,它接收流媒体视频,以及用户在最初时间戳上讲话的地面真实记录,以及用户从未发言的会话的中性开口查询(例如“帮助我组装这盏灯”)。

blocks.en: We also evaluate two open-source baselines that support voice interaction. The cascaded baseline (+ ASR/TTS cascade in Table 1 ) pairs ProAssist with Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Shi et al. (2026) for the user’s speech and IndexTTS2 Zhou et al. (2026) for the assistant’s speech, using the same per-session reference speaker as our benchmark. We assume ideal zero latency between ASR, ProAssist, and TTS, so that each utterance begins playing at the chunk where ProAssist generates it and only the duration of the synthesized speech affects when it ends. The end-to-end baseline is MiniCPM-o 4.5 Cui et al. (2026) (9B) in a zero-shot setting, which also serves as EgoVoice’s backbone before fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估两个支持语音互动的开源基线。 级联基线(+表1中的ASR/TTS级联) Shi等 (2026),指用户的演讲,而IndexTTS2 Zhou等(2026)指助理的演讲,使用同一位每会的参考演讲者作为我们的基准. 我们假设在ASR,ProAssist,和TTS之间有理想的零耐久性,这样,每个语音开始在ProAsist生成它的块上播放,并且只有合成的语音的持续时间会影响它结束的时候. 端到端基线为MiniCPM-o 4.5 Cui等 (2026 (9B)) 在零镜头设定下,在微调前还充当了EgoVoice的骨干.

blocks.en: Our Models. We evaluate EgoVoice-SFT, trained with SFT on our processed data, and EgoVoice-DPO, which further refines EgoVoice-SFT with DPO on intervention timing.
blocks.zh: 我们的模特儿 我们对EgoVoice-SFT进行了评价,对EgoVoice-SFT进行了关于我们处理的数据的SFT培训,并对EgoVoice-DPO进行了评价,对EgoVoice-SFT与DPO进行了关于干预时间的进一步完善.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. For SFT, we apply LoRA ( r = 32 r{=}32 , α = 64 \alpha{=}64 ) to both the LLM backbone and the speech-token decoder, training for 5 epochs on 13,676 windows with a learning rate of 2e-4 and a batch size of 32. For DPO, we train EgoVoice-SFT with β = 0.1 \beta{=}0.1 for 1 epoch with a learning rate of 5e-6 and a batch size of 16, and select the checkpoint based on validation performance. Additional details are provided in Appendices A.2 and A.3 .
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 对SFT来说,我们将LORA(r = 32 r{=}32,α = 64\alpha{=}64)应用于LLM主干线和语音调音器解码器,对13 676个窗口的5个时代进行培训,学习率为2e-4,批量大小为32. 对于DPO,我们用β=0.1\β=0.1\β{=}0.1来训练EgoVoice-SFT,为1个纪元,学习率为5e-6,分批大小为16个,并根据验证性能选择检查站. 更多详情载于附录A.2和A.3。

blocks.en: 5.1 Model Comparison
blocks.zh: 5.1 模型比较

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that off-the-shelf models struggle to produce well-timed proactive interventions. The closed-source APIs all achieve F1 scores of at most 0.03, as they rely on server-side VAD that triggers responses only when the user speaks; since users are largely silent during physical tasks, these models rarely find an occasion to intervene. MiniCPM-o 4.5 in a zero-shot setting performs better (F1 = 0.113) by virtue of its listen-or-speak mechanism, but its judge scores are the lowest overall (Overall = 1.41), reflecting a tendency to narrate observed actions rather than provide task-relevant guidance. The same behavior shows up in its end-vs-action, where a tail of very long narrations pulls the mean far below the median ( − - 4.69s against − - 0.40s).
blocks.zh: 表1显示,现成模式难以产生及时的主动干预措施。 闭源API都以最多0.03分达到F1分,因为他们依靠服务器侧VAD,只有在用户说话时才会触发响应;由于用户在物理任务期间基本上保持沉默,这些模型很少找到干预的机会. 在零镜头设定中,MiniCPM-o 4.5的性能较好(F1=0.113),因为它的听-说机制,但其评分是总体最低的(Overall=1.41),反映了一种对所观察到的行动进行叙述而不是提供与任务相关的指导的倾向. 同样的行为也出现在了它的端-vs-动作中,其中一尾非常长的叙述将平均值拉得远远低于中位数(−- 4.69s对−-0.40s).

blocks.en: EgoVoice-SFT substantially improves over MiniCPM-o 4.5 across all metrics, with p < 10 − 12 10^{-12} on both onset F1 and LLM Judge (Overall). EgoVoice-SFT also outperforms ProAssist on F1 score (0.274 vs 0.195, p < 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) and cosine similarity (0.684 vs 0.594), even though ProAssist is a text-only model evaluated using text-llm . Nevertheless, ProAssist achieves the highest Efficiency score among all models. It speaks less often than EgoVoice and in longer turns (2.2 utterances of 16.6 words per session, against 5.6 utterances of 7.8 words), with almost no brief acknowledgements: utterances of three words or fewer make up 0.8% of its output, against 19.3% for EgoVoice-DPO and 17.9% for the instructor. The Efficiency axis appears to favor this turn structure (Appendix A.6.3 ).
blocks.zh: EgoVoice-SFT在所有度量衡上比MiniCPM-o 4.5大有改进,在F1和LLM法官(Overall)中都使用 < p 10 - 12 10 - 12}。 EgoVoice-SFT在F1分数(0.274对0.195,p < 10 − 4 10^{-4})和同弦相似性(0.684对0.594)上也超越了ProAsist,尽管ProAsist是一个仅使用文本-llm评价的文本模型. 尽管如此,ProAsist还是在所有模型中都取得了"效率"最高分. 它比EgoVoice语的频率更低,而且更长的转折(2.2个每会16.6个字,而7.8个字的语音为5.6个字),几乎没有简短的承认:3个字或更小的语音占其产出的0.8%,而EgoVoice-DPO语为19.3%,教员为17.9%。 效率轴似乎赞成这种转向结构(附录A.6.3)。

blocks.en: Turning ProAssist into a spoken assistant (+ ASR/TTS cascade in Table 1 ) does not close the gap: because the cascade inherits ProAssist’s intervention decisions, its onset F1 is unchanged at 0.195. In addition, the cascade’s speech ends after the user has already begun the linked action in 62.0% of matched interventions, against 24.3% for EgoVoice-SFT and 28.2% for EgoVoice-DPO, giving it negative mean and median end-vs-action values. Deciding when to speak is therefore not sufficient on its own, because the length of the resulting speech determines whether the guidance arrives before it is needed.
blocks.zh: 将ProAssist变为口语助理(+表1中的ASR/TTS级联)并不能弥补差距:由于级联继承了ProAssist的干预决定,其发端F1不变为0.195. 此外,在用户已经开始了62.0%的对等干预后,级联的演讲结束,而EgoVoice-SFT为24.3%,EgoVoice-DPO为28.2%,给出了负平均值和中位值。 因此,决定何时发言本身并不足够,因为由此产生的发言长度决定了指南是否在需要之前到达。

blocks.en: EgoVoice-SFT and EgoVoice-DPO are the only models with positive end-vs-action by both mean and median, and their margins (+1.57s and +1.75s) are close to the instructor’s own (+1.69s). Between the two, EgoVoice-DPO further improves onset timing, raising F1 by 0.050 ( p = 0.0007) as both precision and recall increase, indicating that DPO encourages the model to intervene at more of the right moments rather than simply producing more speech. This comes at a small cost in content similarity (0.684 to 0.649), while LLM Judge (Overall) does not separate the two variants (95% bootstrap CI [ − 0.224 , 0.072 ] [-0.224,0.072] , p = 0.42). The two stages are thus complementary: EgoVoice-DPO prioritizes intervention timing, while EgoVoice-SFT retains a small edge on content metrics.
blocks.zh: EgoVoice-SFT和EgoVoice-DPO是唯一一个以正末端和中位点为正末端动作的模型,它们的边距(+1.57s和+1.75s)接近教官自己的(+1.69s). 在二者之间,"EgoVoice-DPO"进一步改善了发作时间,将F1提高了0.050 (p = 0.0007)作为精确度和回想度都提高了,表明DPO鼓励模型在更多正确时刻进行干预,而不是简单地产生更多的演讲. 这在内容相似性(0.684至0.649)方面成本很小,而LLM Judge(Overall)并没有将两种变体(95%的靴子CI[−0.224,0.072] [0.224,0.072],p=0.42)分开. 因此,这两个阶段是相辅相成的:EgoVoice-DPO优先安排干预时间,而EgoVoice-SFT在内容度量标准上保留了很小的优势.

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.2 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 2 examines individual design choices. For SFT, removing the recipe from the system prompt so that the model relies solely on video and audio causes the largest degradation across all metrics except end-vs-action. This confirms that procedural context is essential for generating relevant guidance, not just for what to say but also for when to say it. We also examine the effect of gradient detachment between the LLM backbone and the speech-token decoder. Removing detachment yields slightly higher F1 but lower judge scores, suggesting that speech loss gradients flowing into the LLM backbone interfere with content quality.
blocks.zh: 表2审查了个别设计选择。 对SFT来说,从系统上删除食谱即时,使模型完全依赖于视频和音频,导致除端-vs-动作外所有度量中最大的降解. 这证实,程序背景对于产生相关指导至关重要,不仅对于说些什么,而且对于何时说。 我们还审查了LLM主干线和语音调试器之间梯度分解的影响。 移除分解产生略高的F1但较低的评分,说明流入LLM主干线的语音损失梯度会干扰内容质量.

blocks.en: For DPO, we first compare three loss variants: length-normalized DPO Lambert et al. (2025) , which normalizes by sequence length; vanilla DPO Rafailov et al. (2023) ; and SimPO Meng et al. (2024) , a reference-free variant. All three improve F1 over SFT, with modest differences among them: trade-offs across cosine similarity and judge scores rather than clear wins. We select length-normalized DPO as our default because it provides the most balanced performance across timing, content, and end-vs-action metrics.
blocks.zh: 对DPO来说,我们首先比较了三种损失变体:长度常态化的DPO Lambert等人(2025年),按序列长度实现常态化;vanilla DPO Rafailov等人(2023年);和SimPO Meng等人(2024年),无参考变体. 这三个都比SFT改进了F1,它们之间的差别不大:在余弦相似度之间取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 我们选择了长度常态化的DPO作为我们的默认,因为它提供了时间,内容,以及终端-vs-动作度量表之间最平衡的性能.

blocks.en: We then examine the sensitivity to β \beta and the reward strategy. Increasing β \beta beyond 0.10 leads the model to speak more often without meaningful content, which raises recall and superficially improves F1 but degrades precision and other metrics related to response quality. To address the content quality decline, we also construct preference pairs requiring improvement on both F1 and cosine similarity. However, this composite strategy instead leads to degradation in both metrics relative to SFT. Selecting by F1 alone proves more effective, suggesting that a single clear optimization signal is preferable to a composite one in this setting.
blocks.zh: 然后我们审查对β\β的敏感性和奖励策略. β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β 为了解决内容质量下降的问题,我们还构建了需要改进的F1和同位素相似性的偏好配对. 然而,这一综合战略反而导致这两个指标相对于SFT的退化。 仅由F1选择就证明效果更好了,说明在此情况下,一个单一的清晰优化信号比复合信号要好.

blocks.en: 5.3 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.3 人类评价

blocks.en: We additionally run pairwise human preference evaluations on Amazon Mechanical Turk. Each evaluator watches two versions of the same egocentric clip, differing only in which assistant’s spoken response is overlaid in the clip, and selects the preferred assistant or a tie. We recruit 100 workers per comparison and discard those who fail a built-in attention check, retaining 252–267 valid judgments per comparison. The full protocol and the evaluation template are in Appendix A.5 .
blocks.zh: 我们还在亚马逊机械土耳其进行双向人类偏好评价。 每名评价员都观看两个版本的同名自负相片, 我们每次比较都招聘100名工人,并抛弃那些未能进行内在关注检查的人,每次比较都保留252-267项有效的判断。 完整的协议和评价模板载于附录A.5。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , both EgoVoice-SFT and EgoVoice-DPO are preferred over MiniCPM-o 4.5 ( p < 0.05), confirming that the improvements observed in automatic metrics translate to perceptible gains in human judgment. Evaluators show a slight numerical preference for DPO over SFT, but the difference is not significant ( p = 0.60), suggesting that the timing gains from DPO and the content advantage of SFT are perceived as comparably valuable.
blocks.zh: 如表3所显示的,EgoVoice-SFT和EgoVoice-DPO都比MiniCPM-o 4.5(p < 0.05)更受青睐,证实所观察到的自动度量法的改进会转化为人类判断中可察觉到的收益. 评价者对DPO略微偏好于SFT,但差别不大(p=0.60),说明从DPO获得的时间收益和SFT的内容优势被认为相若有价值.

blocks.en: 5.4 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 分析

blocks.en: Table 3: Pairwise human preference evaluation results.
blocks.zh: 表3:对等的人类偏好评价结果。

blocks.en: Intervention Ordering. Onset F1 measures whether interventions land at the right moments, but not whether they follow the order of the task, since the Hungarian matching pairs each prediction with a reference independently of every other pair. A model could therefore match many references while explaining a later step before an earlier one. We test this with Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} , a rank correlation that counts how often two orderings agree on which of a pair of items comes first, ranging from − 1 -1 for a reversed order to 1 1 for an identical one, with a correction for tied ranks Kendall (1945) . We compute it per session between the order in which the model produced its matched interventions and the order of the references they matched. Over sessions with at least two matched pairs, EgoVoice-DPO reaches 0.868 and EgoVoice-SFT 0.841, against 0.850 for ProAssist and 0.749 for MiniCPM-o 4.5. The trained models thus move through the task in close to the order the instructor did, while the zero-shot backbone is markedly less consistent.
blocks.zh: 干预令. 设定 F1 测量干预是否在正确的时刻着陆,而不是它们是否遵循任务的顺序,因为匈牙利人将每对预测与一个参考进行匹配,独立于其他每对. 因此,一个模型可以匹配许多参考文献,同时在前面解释一个后期步骤。 我们用Kendall的\b tau_{b}来测试这一点, 等级关系可以算出两个订单的频率, 我们按模型产生相应发言的顺序和它们相应参考的顺序来计算。 EgoVoice-DPO在至少有两对匹配的会话中达到0.868和EgoVoice-SFT0.841,ProAssist为0.850,MiniCPM-o 4.5为0.749。 因此,训练有素的模型在接近教官所完成的顺序的情况下完成任务,而零发主干线则明显缺乏一致性。

blocks.en: Content Alignment. A model could deliver guidance in the right order yet phrase it generically enough to fit any nearby step, which onset matching alone would not detect. For each matched pair we therefore compare the prediction against its matched reference and the two references before and the two after it, using the same cosine similarity as our Content Relevance metric, and record which is closest. The matched reference is closest for 59.5% of EgoVoice-SFT pairs and 52.8% of EgoVoice-DPO, against 45.9% for ProAssist and 31.8% for MiniCPM-o 4.5. All systems thus carry some step-specific content, but the trained models are the most locally precise.
blocks.zh: 内容对齐。 一个模型可以按正确的顺序提供指导,但一般来说它足以适应任何相邻的步骤,而光靠起发匹配是无法探测的。 因此,对于每对匹配的对子,我们将预测与其对应的参考文献以及前后的两起参考文献进行比较,使用与我们Content Relations implement implement相同的同位素相似度,并记录最接近的。 与之相匹配的参考率最接近的是59.5%的EgoVoice-SFT对和52.8%的EgoVoice-DPO对,而ProAssist的参考率为45.9%,而MiniCPM-o 4.5的参考率为31.8%。 因此,所有系统都包含一些特定步骤的内容,但经过培训的模型是当地最精确的。

blocks.en: Table 4: Distribution of utterance types on the 170 benchmark sessions (%). Each utterance is classified as proactive guidance, third-person scene narration, or other. The first row is the reference instructor speech.
blocks.zh: 表4:170个基准会话的语音类型分布情况(%)。 每句话都被归类为主动指导,第三人称场景叙述等. 第一行是参考教官演讲.

blocks.en: Utterance Types. Neither timing nor content metrics say what kind of speech a model produces. We classify every delivered utterance, and every reference utterance from the human instructors, into proactive guidance, third-person scene narration, and other using gpt-5.6-luna (Table 4 ; the prompt and protocol are in Appendix A.4 ). Our models deliver guidance more often than the backbone and bring narration close to the instructors’ level. What remains is the other category, which for every system consists mostly of brief acknowledgments: 70.7% of EgoVoice-DPO’s are three words or fewer. EgoVoice-SFT and EgoVoice-DPO generate more of them than the instructors, and that gap accounts for most of the remaining distance to the reference distribution.
blocks.zh: 特异性类型. 时间和内容的衡量标准都说不出一个模型会产生什么样的语音. 我们把每个发来的言词以及人类教官的每一个参考语句归类为主动指导、第三人称场景描述以及使用gpt-5.6-luna的其他语句(表4;即时和协议载于附录A.4)。 我们的模型提供的指导比主干要多,并让叙述接近教员的水平。 剩下的是另一个类别,对每个系统来说,这主要包括简短的承认:70.7%的EgoVoice-DPO是三个或更少的词. EgoVoice-SFT和EgoVoice-DPO产生比导师更多,而这一差距占了参考分布所余距离的大部分.

blocks.en: Failure Modes. Quantitative results in Table 1 hide two failure modes. First, a positive mean end-vs-action does not guarantee the model finishes in time: EgoVoice-DPO still finishes after the user has begun the linked action in 28.2% of matched interventions and EgoVoice-SFT in 24.3%, which is well below MiniCPM-o 4.5 (54.5%) and the cascade (62.0%), but far from solved. Second, recall is the binding constraint: at a recall of 0.285, EgoVoice-DPO misses most moments where the instructor intervened. Appendix A.6.5 groups examples of each by failure type.
blocks.zh: 失败模式。 表1中的定量结果隐藏了两种失败模式. 首先,一个正中端-Vs-动作并不能保证模型及时完成:EgoVoice-DPO仍然在用户在28.2%的对应干预中开始连接动作后完成,而EgoVoice-SFT则在24.3%,远低于MiniCPM-o 4.5 (54.5%)和级联(62.0%),但远未解决. 第二,回顾是有约束力的限制:在0.285的回顾中,EgoVoice-DPO错过了教员干预的大部分时间。 附录A.6.5按故障类型列出每个实例。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. We constructed a spoken interaction dataset from HoloAssist through source separation and speech resynthesis, and proposed an evaluation protocol covering intervention timing, content relevance, and overall assistance quality. Through supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization on MiniCPM-o 4.5, we showed that both EgoVoice-SFT and EgoVoice-DPO outperform all baselines on onset F1 and content relevance. We hope that EgoVoice serves as an initial step toward building always-on spoken assistants that can proactively guide users through real-world tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了“EgoVoice”方案,这是培训和评估主动自我中心语言助理的框架。 通过源码分离和语音合成,我们构建了HoloAssist的语音互动数据集,并提出了一个涵盖干预时间、内容相关性和总体援助质量的评价协议。 通过对MiniCPM-o 4.5进行监督的微调和直接优化偏好,我们显示,EgoVoice-SFT和EgoVoice-DPO在起动F1和内容相关性方面都超过了所有基线。 我们希望,EgoVoice是逐步建立能够主动指导用户完成现实世界任务的常客助理的第一步。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: While we demonstrated the potential of egocentric proactive spoken assistance, our framework has several limitations. First, from a data perspective, our dataset is constructed from HoloAssist, which covers a specific set of procedural assembly tasks. As a result, the model’s ability to generalize to other domains such as cooking, outdoor navigation, or social interaction is not guaranteed. In addition, there is still a substantial performance gap between our model and the ground truth instructor behavior (Appendix A.6.2 ), suggesting that more diverse training data and larger-scale training would be needed to approach human-level proactive assistance.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们显示了以自我为中心的主动口头援助的潜力,但我们的框架有一些局限性。 首先,从数据角度看,我们的数据集是从HoloAssist构建的,它涵盖了一套具体的程序组装任务. 因此,该模型一般化到烹饪、户外航行或社会互动等其他领域的能力得不到保障。 此外,我们的模型与地面真相教员行为(附录A.6.2)之间仍然存在很大的性能差距,这表明需要更多样化的培训数据和更大规模的培训,以取得人的主动援助。

blocks.en: Second, our backbone model, MiniCPM-o 4.5, occasionally exhibits several issues that we observed during our experiments, including excessively long responses, severe repetition, and occasional language switching (e.g., generating Chinese tokens or unrecognizable special characters in the middle of English utterances). Although these artifacts are reduced through our fine-tuning, they still carry over into both EgoVoice-SFT and EgoVoice-DPO, as LoRA adapts only a small subset of model parameters. The model also inherits the one-second chunk granularity of MiniCPM-o 4.5, which may limit the precision of intervention timing in scenarios that require sub-second responsiveness.
blocks.zh: 其次,我们的骨干模型"MiniCPM-o 4.5"偶尔会显示我们在实验中观察到的几个问题,包括反应过长,严重重复,偶尔语言切换(例如:在英语发音中间产生出中式活字或无法识别的特殊字符). 虽然这些文物通过我们的微调而减少,但是它们仍然会传入"EgoVoice-SFT"和"EgoVoice-DPO"两个部分,因为"LORA"只适应了一小部分模型参数. 该模型还继承了MiniCPM-o 4.5的一分块颗粒性,这可能会限制在需要分秒响应的情景中干预时间的精确性.

blocks.en: Third, our evaluation is conducted on prerecorded sessions: the user’s actions are already fixed, so every model is scored against behavior that is independent of its own advice. Our numbers should therefore be read as a proxy for interactive performance rather than a measurement of it. We also do not model overlap between the two speakers: each utterance plays to completion, so the protocol covers neither a user interrupting the assistant nor the assistant yielding mid-utterance. Handling barge-in in both directions is necessary for deployment and is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们的评价是在预先录制的会话中进行的:用户的行动已经固定,因此每个模型都根据独立于自己建议的行为来评分. 因此,我们的数字应被理解为互动业绩的取而代之,而不是对其的衡量。 我们还不模拟两位发言者之间的重叠:每一次发言都进行到完成,因此协议既不包括打断助理的用户,也不包括达到中点的助理。 在两个方向上处理驳船是部署所必须的,并留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Fourth, our DPO stage improves intervention timing but introduces a slight decline in content quality, indicating that the reward signal has room for further refinement. Finally, deploying an always-on spoken assistant in real-world settings raises privacy risks: continuous egocentric recording may capture bystanders without consent, and transmitting audio and video to external servers risks exposing sensitive information. Mitigating these risks will require bystander consent mechanisms, on-device processing to minimize data transmission, and audio redaction protocols. Nevertheless, with growing industry investment in AR and smart glasses, we believe open-source contributions toward proactive spoken assistance will become increasingly valuable, and we hope our dataset, code, and models will serve as a useful foundation for this emerging direction.
blocks.zh: 第四,我们的DPO阶段改进了干预时间,但内容质量略有下降,表明奖励信号有进一步改进的余地。 最后,在现实世界环境中部署一个总是在说话的助理会带来隐私风险:持续以自我为中心的录音可能会不经同意而捕获旁观者,将音频和视频传输到外部服务器可能会暴露出敏感信息. 减轻这些风险需要旁观者同意机制、尽量减少数据传输的在线设备处理以及音频编辑协议。 尽管如此,随着业界对AR和智能眼镜的投资不断增加,我们认为开放源码对主动口头援助的贡献将变得日益有价值,我们希望我们的数据集、代码和模型将成为这一新兴方向的有益基础。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Our dataset is derived from HoloAssist Wang et al. (2023) , released under CDLAv2, which permits redistribution and derivative works, and we use all artifacts consistently with their intended use (Appendix A.7 ). The original recordings anonymize speaker identities by pitch shifting, and our resynthesis replaces every voice with zero-shot TTS output from reference speakers in Multilingual LibriSpeech Pratap et al. (2020) (CC BY 4.0), a corpus built from public-domain LibriVox audiobook recordings. Both corpora identify speakers only by numeric identifiers; the speech we release is entirely synthetic, and the separated background channel is verified to contain no residual speech (Section 3.1 ). No voice in our data can therefore be linked to a named person, and we will preserve this property in any future version of the dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们的数据集取自HoloAssist Wang et al. (2023),在CDLav2下发布,允许再分配和衍生作品,我们使用所有与预定用途一致的文物(附录A.7.). 最初的录音通过投出移位来匿名化扬声器身份,我们的再合成用多语种LibriSpeech Pratap等人(2020年)的参考发言者的零镜头TTS输出来取代每一个语音(CC BY 4.0),这是由公共域名LibriVox音频录制而成的. 两只蝎子都只通过数字识别识别来识别扬声器;我们发布的讲话是完全合成的,而分离后的背景通道被验证为没有剩余演说(第3.1节. 因此,我们数据中的任何声音都不能与一个被命名的人相连接,我们将在今后的任何版本的数据集中保留这个属性.

blocks.en: For the human evaluation, we recruited workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk, compensated them for each completed task, and collected no personally identifying information beyond what the platform requires; the protocol is described in Appendix A.5 . Beyond the study itself, an always-on assistant that continuously records first-person video and audio carries risks for the user and for bystanders. We discuss these risks and possible mitigations in the Limitations section, and we release our models for research on proactive assistance rather than for deployment as a monitoring tool.
blocks.zh: 为了进行人类评估,我们在Amazon Machanical Turk上招聘了工人,补偿他们完成的每一项任务,没有收集超出平台要求的个人识别信息;协议在附录A.5中描述。 除了研究本身外,一个总是不断记录第一人称视频和音频的助理为用户和旁观者带来风险. 我们在限制部分讨论这些风险和可能的缓解措施,我们公布我们的模型,用于主动援助研究,而不是作为监测工具加以部署。

blocks.en: A.1 Data Construction Details
blocks.zh: A.1 数据构建细节

blocks.en: Source Separation. The original HoloAssist recordings contain a single mono audio channel in which user speech, instructor speech, and background sounds are mixed together. Since all voices are pitch-shifted for anonymization, they cannot be used directly for training a natural-sounding spoken assistant. We therefore isolate only the background sounds using SAM-Audio (large-tv variant 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/facebook/sam-audio-large-tv ), a prompt-based source separation model that takes an audio mixture and a reference audio prompt, extracts the sound matching the prompt, and returns both the extracted target and its residual.
blocks.zh: 出处分出. 最初的HoloAssist录音包含一个单声道,其中用户语音,教官语音,和背景声音相混合. 由于所有声音都用于无名化,因此不能直接用于训练一个自然发声的口语助理. 因此,我们只用 SAM-Audio (大-tv 变体 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/facebook/sam-audio-great-tv) 来隔离背景声音,这是一种快速的源分化模型,它使用音频混合物和参考音频快取出匹配的快取出声音,同时返回被取出的目标及其残留.

blocks.en: Since our goal is to preserve the background sounds while removing all human voices, we provide the speech segments as prompts so that SAM-Audio extracts and discards them, and we retain the residual as the background channel. For each speech-containing interval identified from the HoloAssist metadata timestamps, we supply the raw voice segment with a ± \pm 0.2 second margin as the conditioning region to avoid sharp boundary artifacts in the separated output. To verify that no human voice remains in the resulting background, we apply Silero VAD to the separated background and discard all sessions where residual speech is still detected.
blocks.zh: 由于我们的目标是保留背景声音,同时去除所有人类声音,所以我们提供语音片段作为提示,让SAM-Audio取出并抛弃它们,我们保留剩余部分作为背景通道. 对于从HoloAssist元数据时间戳中确认的每个包含语音的间隔,我们向原始语音段提供±\pm 0.2秒比值作为调节区来避免分离输出中的尖端边界文物. 为了核实由此产生的背景中没有人类的声音,我们将Silero VAD应用到分离的背景中,并丢弃所有仍然被检测到剩余发言的会话.

blocks.en: Text Normalization. To synthesize user and assistant speech that is free of pitch shifting, preserves speaker anonymity, and is separated into distinct audio channels suitable for training, we first normalize the written-form dialog transcripts available in HoloAssist’s metadata using a two-stage LLM pipeline with gpt-5.4-mini . In Stage A, a generator model receives the full conversation session and applies a text normalization covering spelling correction, punctuation standardization, canonical filler-word handling, and proper-noun formatting. The original HoloAssist conversations also contain task-irrelevant opening and closing remarks related to starting or stopping the recording (e.g., “You can start recording now” or “We are done, you can stop”). These are identified using per-utterance metadata flags from the original annotations and removed, accounting for 9.0% of all utterances. In Stage B, an independent reviewer model ( gpt-5.4-mini ) re-checks the Stage A output for faithfulness and consistency.
blocks.zh: 文本规范化. 我们首先将HoloAssist元数据中可用的书面形式对话记录文本正常化, 在A阶段,一个生成器模型接收了完整的对讲会话,并应用了包括拼写校正,标出标准化,单词填字处理,以及正名格式化的文本正常化. 最初的HoloAssist对话中也包含与任务无关的开场和结束语,与开始或停止录音有关(如"你现在可以开始录音"或"我们完成了,你可以停止"). 使用原注解中的每句元数据标记来识别这些内容,并取出,占所有言论的9.0%. 在B阶段,一个独立的审查员模式(gpt-5.4-mini )重新检查A阶段的产出,以确定其可靠性和一致性。

The eval split consists of the surviving sessions from the original HoloAssist evaluation split and is not further filtered.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Why naive TTS synthesis on video-text dialog data is insufficient. The ground truth instructor (top) times utterances to finish before the user’s next action. Naive TTS (middle) generates longer speech that overlaps with the user’s action. Shifting the onset earlier (bottom) avoids the action overlap but collides with the previous utterance and delivers guidance before the user has seen the relevant context. This motivates our choice to start from HoloAssist, where real instructor speech timing is already aligned with user actions, and to resynthesize speech with a strict duration constraint that preserves this alignment.
blocks.zh: 图4:为什么视频-文本对话框数据上的天真TTS合成不足. 地面真言导师(顶级)在用户下次行动前发言完毕。 Naive TTS(中)生成与用户动作相重叠的更长的语音. 提前(从下到下)移动启动,避免了动作重叠,但在用户看到相关上下文之前,与先前的言论相会合并提供指导。 这促使我们选择从HoloAssist开始,在HoloAssist中,真正的教官演讲时间已经与用户动作一致,并且以严格的持续时间限制来重新合成演讲,以保持这种对齐.

blocks.en: Speech Resynthesis. With the transcripts normalized for synthesis, we resynthesize clean speech using IndexTTS2 Zhou et al. (2026) , a speaker-adaptive zero-shot TTS model. For each session, we assign one reference speaker to the user and one to the instructor, drawn from the English subset of Multilingual LibriSpeech Pratap et al. (2020) (2,498 training speakers, 340 disjoint evaluation speakers). Each utterance is synthesized 20 times, and candidates longer than the original utterance duration are discarded to prevent the synthesized speech from extending into the time window where the user performs the next physical action. From the remaining candidates, we transcribe each with Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Shi et al. (2026) and select the one with the lowest word error rate (WER) against the normalized transcript. Sessions whose selected utterances all achieve WER = 0.0% are automatically retained; all others are manually checked, and any session containing even one incorrectly pronounced utterance is discarded.
blocks.zh: 演说回想. 随着语录的正规化用于合成,我们使用IndexTTS2 Zhou等(2026年)重新合成了干净的语音,一种能发声的零发TTS模型. 在每届会议上,我们为用户指派一名参考资料员,为教员指派一名资料员,该资料员取自多种语言LibriSpeech Pratap et al.(2020年)英文专集(2 498名训练员,340名不联合评价员)。 每句话被合成了20次,而候选人的时间长于最初的语音时间被丢弃,以防止被合成的语音延伸到用户进行下个物理动作的时间窗口. 从其余的考生中,我们分别以Qune3-ASR-1.7B Shi等(2026年)来转录,并选取文字出错率最低(WER)的考生与正版记录. 选择的语句全部达到 WER = 0.0% 的会话会被自动保留;其他的都会被手动检查,任何包含一个不正确发音的会话都会被丢弃.

blocks.en: Dataset Attrition. Table 5 summarizes the number of sessions retained at each stage of the data construction pipeline. The largest reduction occurs at the source separation stage, where 141 sessions are discarded due to residual speech detected in the separated background.
blocks.zh: 数据集分解. 表5汇总了数据构建管道各阶段保留的会议次数。 减少幅度最大的是在源分离阶段,由于在分离的背景中检测出残留的语音,141个会话被丢弃.

blocks.en: A.2 Baseline Configurations
blocks.zh: A.2 基线配置

blocks.en: Gemini Live API. The Gemini Live API is Google’s low-latency real-time API for streaming audio, video frames, and text, generating spoken responses. We use gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio 3 3 3 https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/gemini/2-5-flash-live-api through Vertex AI with JPEG video frames at 1 fps resized to 768 × \times 768, context-window compression and proactive audio enabled, and a 15-second tail wait after all video frames are sent to allow the model to finish generating.
blocks.zh: 双子座活API. 双子座活API是Google低频实时API,用于流传音频,视频帧和文本,生成口语响应. 我们使用Gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio 3 3 https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-incounter-agent-platform/models/gemini/2-5-flash-live-api 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-02. 结束 Vertex AI 与 JPEG 视频帧在 1 fps 时被调整为 768 ×\times 768,上下文窗口压缩和主动音频启用,并在所有视频帧发送后有 15 秒尾等,使模型完成生成.

blocks.en: OpenAI Realtime API. The OpenAI Realtime API enables low-latency speech-to-speech interaction with GPT-class models over WebSocket. We evaluate two snapshots, gpt-realtime 4 4 4 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-realtime and gpt-realtime-2 5 5 5 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-realtime-2 , with the alloy voice, server-side VAD for turn detection, and video frames at 1 fps (768 px). Input audio is 16-bit PCM at 24 kHz.
blocks.zh: OpenAI 实时 API. OpenAI Realtime API在WebSocket上允许与GPT类模型进行低频语音对语音交互. 我们评价两个快照:gpt-realtime 4 4 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-realtime和gpt-realtime-2 5 5 5 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-realtime-2,合金语音,服务器侧VAD用于转弯检测,视频帧为1 ps (768 px). 输入音频为16位PCM,位于24千赫.

blocks.en: Both the Gemini Live API and OpenAI Realtime API rely on voice activity detection to trigger responses, meaning they respond primarily when the user speaks. Since users are largely silent during physical tasks in our setting, these models rarely intervene: the average number of utterances per session is 0.25 for Gemini Live, 0.79 for gpt-realtime-2 , and 0.94 for gpt-realtime . We also remove background noise from the input audio for these models to prevent false VAD triggering, providing a more favorable evaluation condition, though the results suggest that these models are not designed for proactive assistance in this setting.
blocks.zh: 双子座Live API和OpenAI Realtime API都依靠语音活性检测来触发响应,指它们主要在用户说话时响应. 由于用户在我们环境中的物理任务期间基本上保持沉默,这些模型很少介入:每会话的平均发音数为双子座Live为0.25个,gpt-realtime-2为0.79个,gpt-realtime为0.94个. 我们还从这些模型的输入音频中去除背景噪声,以防止虚假的 VAD 触发,提供了一个更有利的评价条件,尽管结果显示这些模型的设计不是为了在这一背景下的主动援助.

blocks.en: ProAssist. ProAssist Zhang et al. (2025c) is an 8B open-source video-text model built on VideoLLM-Online Chen et al. (2024) that learns proactive dialog generation from streaming egocentric video. It handles text rather than speech and does not accept audio input. We use the default settings from the original paper and official implementation, with native 2 fps video at 384 × \times 384 resolution. In the cascade variant, the ground-truth user transcripts are replaced by Qwen3-ASR-1.7B transcripts of the resynthesized user speech, and ProAssist’s text output is synthesized with IndexTTS2.
blocks.zh: 普贤行相. 支持主义 张等 (2025c)是一款由VideoLLM-Online Chen等 (2024)所建的8B开源视频文本模型,从流出自心视频中学习主动对话生成. 它处理文本而不是语音,不接受音频输入. 我们使用原始纸和官方执行的默认设置, 本地 2 fps 视频以 384 ×\times 384 分辨率。 在级联变体中,地-真用户笔录被再合成用户语音的Qune3-ASR-1.7B笔录所取代,ProAssist的文本输出被IndexTTS2所合成.

blocks.en: MiniCPM-o 4.5. MiniCPM-o 4.5 Cui et al. (2026) is a 9B open-source omni-modal model that supports real-time full-duplex interaction across vision, speech, and text. It serves as our backbone before fine-tuning. We evaluate it in a zero-shot setting with a system prompt that provides the task name and step-by-step procedural instructions, using temperature = 0.7, top- p p = 0.8, and top- k k = 100. Unlike the closed-source APIs that rarely speak, MiniCPM-o 4.5 generates an average of 4.85 utterances per session. However, an analysis of all 825 utterances across the 170 benchmark sessions reveals that only 30.1% constitute proactive guidance (Table 4 ). The remaining utterances are third-person scene narration (21.0%, e.g., “The person is unscrewing the leg”), which is inappropriate for a first-person assistant, or acknowledgements, greetings, and hallucinated text (49.0%, e.g., “Is Jesus Christ”, “Oh”, or garbled tokens).
blocks.zh: 迷你CPM -o 4.5. MiniCPM-o 4.5 Cui等 (2026)是一款9B开源全能模式,支持跨视觉,语音,文本的实时全能交互. 在微调前,它是我们的支柱。 我们以零发设定来评价它,系统提示提供任务名称和分步程序指令,使用温度=0.7,上-p=0.8,上-克=100. 与很少说话的封闭源代码API不同,MiniCPM-o 4.5平均每会生成4.85个语音. 然而,对170次基准会议所有825次发言的分析表明,只有30.1%是主动指导(表4)。 其余的言论是第三人称场景叙事(21.0%,例如“某人正在解开腿”),这不适合第一人称助理,也不适合致谢、问候和有幻觉的文字(49.0%,例如“是耶稣基督”、“哦”还是带了装饰物)。

blocks.zh: A.3 训练超参数

blocks.en: A.4 Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: A.4 评价细节

blocks.en: LLM Judge. We prompt gpt-5.4-mini 6 6 6 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.4-mini (reasoning effort = medium) with the full session context, including all reference and predicted utterances with their timestamps. Our judge prompt and scoring rubric are largely adapted from ProAssist Zhang et al. (2025c) . The judge rates each session on four axes on a 1-to-5 Likert scale: Correctness, Promptness, Efficiency, and Overall. The full system prompt is shown in Figure 5 .
blocks.zh: LLM法官。 我们以整个会话背景,包括所有参考语句和带有时间戳的预测语句,促进gpt-5.4-mini 6 6 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.4-mini(合理努力=中)。 我们的评委迅速和得分的分数主要改编自ProAssist Zhang等 (2025c). 法官按1至5个类似比例按四个轴进行评分:正确性、迅速性、效率和总体。 图5显示整个系统提示。

blocks.en: Figure 5: System prompt used for LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. The model is forced to emit a strict JSON schema with five keys: analysis , correctness , promptness , efficiency , overall (latter four integers 1-5).
blocks.zh: 图5:用于作为法官的LLM评价的系统提示。 该模型被迫放出一个严格的JSON schema,有5个键:分析,正确性,即时性,效率,整体(排出4个整数 1-5).

blocks.en: Figure 6: Prompt used for action-linked utterance classification with majority voting (strict-majority over 5 independent calls at temperature 1.0 1.0 ; ties resolved by the most frequent label). Response is enforced as strict JSON {is_directive ∈ \in {yes, no, ambiguous}, rationale} .
blocks.zh: 图6: 与行动有关的言论与多数投票的分类(在1.01.0温度下,5个独立电话的严格多数;关系由最频繁的标签解决) 作为严格的JSON {is_ direction }\ in {是,不是,模棱两可的}, 理由}执行。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Prompt used for utterance type classification. The label is the strict majority over 5 independent calls.
blocks.zh: 图7:用于语音类型分类的快速。 标签是5个独立电话的严格多数。

blocks.en: Action-Linked Classification. To construct the action-linked evaluation subset for end-vs-action timing, we classify each reference utterance as either a procedural directive (e.g., “change the battery”) or a non-directive remark (e.g., acknowledgement, encouragement) using gpt-5.5 7 7 7 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.5 (reasoning effort = high) with 5-way self-consistency majority voting at temperature = 1.0. Procedural directives are linked to the user’s nearest subsequent physical action from HoloAssist’s action annotations within a temporal window of T T = 5 seconds. This retains 942 out of 2,067 total reference utterances across 170 benchmark sessions. The classification prompt is shown in Figure 6 .
blocks.zh: 动作链接分类. 为了构建与行动有关的评价子集,用于终端-Vs-行动时间,我们把每个参考语归类为程序指令(如“改变电池”)或使用gpt-5.5的无指令性评论(如确认、鼓励),7 7 7 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.5。 (合理努力 = 高 ) , 温度下有5个途径的自相容多数投票 = 1.0. 。 程序指令与用户在HoloAsist的动作说明中最近的物理动作相联,时间窗口为 T T = 5秒。 这保留了170个基准会议2 067个参考发言中的942个。 分类快报见图6。

blocks.en: Utterance Type Classification. To characterize what kind of speech each system generates (Table 4 ), we classify every delivered utterance, and every reference instructor utterance, as proactive guidance, third-person scene narration, or other. We use gpt-5.6-luna 8 8 8 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-luna with the prompt in Figure 7 , taking the strict majority over 5 independent calls. The same prompt is applied to model output and to reference utterances so that the two are directly comparable. Across the four sources, 91.6% to 96.3% of utterances received a unanimous label.
blocks.zh: 紫外线类型分类. 为了描述每个系统产生什么样的语音(表4),我们把每个发送的语音和每个参考导师的语音归类为主动指导、第三人称场景描述或其他。 我们使用gpt-5.6-luna 8 8 8 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-luna,图7给出了提示,严格多数采用5个独立电话。 对模型输出和参考语句也采用了同样的快取,这样两者就可直接比较. 在四个来源中,91.6%至96.3%的言论得到了一致的标签。

blocks.en: Content Similarity. We compute cosine similarity between reference and predicted utterances using Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Zhang et al. (2025b) . For each matched reference-prediction pair identified by the onset timing metric, we encode both utterances and compute their cosine similarity as a measure of semantic alignment.
blocks.zh: 内容相似。 我们用Qune3-Embedding-0.6B Zhang等人(2025b)计算参考语和预测语的同位素相似性。 对于每一对对应的参考预测对, 由发端时间测量标准确定, 我们编码了语句, 并计算出其同位素相似性, 作为语义相匹配的度量。

blocks.en: ASR Transcription. For the text-asr evaluation channel, we transcribe the generated speech using Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Shi et al. (2026) . To determine utterance boundaries within continuous speech output, we apply Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B Shi et al. (2026) for word-level timestamp alignment, followed by Silero VAD (threshold = 0.5) Silero Team (2024) for utterance segmentation. All artifacts and their licenses are listed in Table 11 (Appendix A.7 ).
blocks.zh: ASR译名. 对于文本-asr评价通道,我们使用Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Shi等人(2026年)转录生成的语音. 为了确定连续语音输出中的语音边界,我们应用了Qune3-ForcedAligner-0.6B Shi等 (2026)用于字位时间戳对接,后由Silero VAD(阈值=0.5) Silero Team(2024)用于语音分接. 所有文物及其许可证列于表11(附录A.7)。

blocks.en: End-of-Utterance Decomposition. On the action-linked subset, every matched prediction has a user action attached to it through the reference utterance it matched. We measure three things against the start of that action: when the predicted utterance begins (start-vs-action), when it ends (end-vs-action), and how long it lasts. Both the onset and the end are read from the generated audio: we anchor the utterance at the chunk in which the model starts speaking and locate its first and last word with Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B. Its duration is therefore the span over which the model is audible, which is shorter than the synthesized audio file since that also contains leading and trailing silence. The three quantities satisfy end-vs-action = start-vs-action - duration for every pair, and hence for their means, though not for their medians. The per-model decomposition is reported in Appendix A.6.2 .
blocks.zh: 终入解相. 在与动作相接的子集上,每个匹配的预测都有一个用户动作通过匹配的参考语句附在其上. 我们对照这个行动的开始来衡量三件事:预测的言论何时开始(开始-vs-action),何时结束(结束-vs-action),以及持续多长时间. 开始和结束都从生成的音频读取:我们把语音定位在模型开始说话的块上,并用Qune3-ForcedAligner-0.6B定位它的第一和最后一个单词. 因此,其持续时间是该模型的可听取的跨度,它比合成音频文件短,因为其中也包含先入后出和后入的沉默. 3个量满足了端-vs-活性=起动-vs-活性-每对的活性,因此也满足了它们的能力,尽管其中位数并非如此。 每型分解情况见附录A.6.2.

blocks.en: A.5 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: A.5 人类评价

blocks.en: The full human evaluation results are described in Section 5.3 . Each clip is centered on a ground truth instructor utterance and the user action it prompts, with temporal margins on both sides for context. We remove the human instructor’s speech and overlay the spoken responses of two anonymous assistants, keeping the original user speech and background audio, so that the two versions of a clip differ only in the assistant.
blocks.zh: 第5.3节叙述了人类评价的全部结果。 每个片段都以地面真理导师的言辞及其引发的用户动作为中心,两边都有时间上下文的空间. 我们删除了人类导师的演讲,并覆盖了两位匿名助理的口头回应,保留了最初的用户演讲和背景音频,这样两个版本的剪辑就只有助理不同了.

blocks.en: We recruit 100 workers per comparison on Amazon Mechanical Turk. Each HIT contains three real A/B comparisons and one attention test (ground truth vs silence); workers who select the wrong answer on the test are excluded from the final scoring, leaving 252–267 valid judgments per comparison. A/B sides are randomized per question, and workers must achieve at least 50% cumulative playback on both clips before submitting. The total cost across all three comparisons is approximately $200. The evaluation template is shown in Figure 8 .

blocks.en: A.6 Additional Results
blocks.zh: A.6 其他结果

blocks.en: A.6.1 Results on the text-llm Channel
blocks.zh: A.6.1 文字-语言频道的结果

blocks.en: Table 7 repeats the evaluation of Table 1 on text-llm , the text a model generates internally, rather than text-asr , the transcription of the speech it actually generates. Most content and judge metrics are slightly higher on text-llm for models that generate speech, as the text is not subject to TTS or ASR noise. End-vs-action also shifts between the two channels. The end of an utterance is measured from the generated audio in both cases, so it does not change. The onset does: on text-asr it is where the speech is first heard, and on text-llm it is the chunk where the model emits the text. Because predictions are matched to references by onset, the two channels score slightly different sets of interventions. The cascade row also serves as an ASR control here: it is ProAssist reading Qwen3-ASR-1.7B transcripts of the user’s speech instead of ground-truth ones, and onset F1 is unchanged at 0.195 while cosine drops by only 0.009. The relative ranking is largely consistent between the two channels. Audio samples of our dataset, qualitative comparisons between EgoVoice and baselines, and additional examples are available on the project page. 9 9 9 https://egocentricvoice.github.io/
blocks.zh: 表7重复了表1对文本-ellm的评价,文本一个模型生成内部而不是文本-asr,其实际生成的语音的抄录. 对于生成语音的模型,大部分内容和判断尺度在文本-llm上略高,因为文本不受TTS或ASR噪声的影响. end-vs-action也介于两个频道之间. 语音的结束从两种情况下生成的音频来测量,所以不会改变. 发音确实如此:在文本-asr上,它是发言的先发地,在文本-llm上,是模型发出文本的块. 由于预测与起讫时的参考相匹配,两个渠道的得分略有不同. 级联行在此也起到ASR控制的作用:是ProAsist读取了用户语音的Qwen3-ASR-1.7B记录稿,而不是地上真实的,发音F1不变为0.195而余弦只下降0.09. 两个频道的相对排名基本一致. 我们的数据集的音频样本、EgoVoice和基线的定性比较以及其他例子可在项目网页上查阅。

blocks.en: A.6.2 End-of-Utterance Decomposition
blocks.zh: A.6.2 终极分解

blocks.en: Table 8 separates end-vs-action into the two quantities that produce it. Every system starts speaking at a broadly similar point relative to the user’s action, between +3.4 and +5.9 seconds. What differs is how long each one talks. EgoVoice-SFT and EgoVoice-DPO speak for 2.99 and 2.93 seconds on average, close to the instructor’s 3.05, while the cascade takes 6.38 seconds, MiniCPM-o 4.5 takes 9.87, and gpt-realtime-2 takes 20.39. Since end-vs-action is start-vs-action minus this duration, utterance length alone accounts for the sign of the result. Deciding when to speak is not the difficult part; finishing in time is.
blocks.zh: 表8将终端-vs-动作分为生产该物质的两种数量。 每个系统开始说话的时间与用户动作大致相近,在+3.4至+5.9秒之间. 不同的是,每个人谈多久。 EgoVoice-SFT和EgoVoice-DPO平均发言2.99和2.93秒,接近教官的3.05,而级联需要6.38秒,MiniCPM-o 4.5需要9.87分,gpt-realtime-2需要20.39分. 由于end-vs-action是起动-vs-action减去这个持续时间,单词长度就说明了结果的标志. 决定何时发言不是困难的部分;及时完成。

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows the individual interventions behind these numbers. The instructor almost never runs late, and the two EgoVoice variants have the same shape with a heavier left tail. The baselines differ in kind rather than degree: the cascade and MiniCPM-o 4.5 sit astride zero, and the three closed-source APIs fall almost entirely below it. The figure also shows why we report medians alongside means. MiniCPM-o 4.5 has a mean of − 4.69 -4.69 but a median of only − 0.40 -0.40 , because a handful of very late endings pull the average down.
blocks.zh: 图9显示了这些数字背后的个别干预措施。 教官几乎从不晚跑,两个"EgoVoice"变体的外形也一样,左尾更重. 基线在实物上不同,在程度上不同:级联和MiniCPM-o 4.5坐地为零,而三个闭源API几乎完全倒地于下. 这一数字还显示,我们为什么报告中位数和手段。 MiniCPM-o 4.5的平均值为-4.69-4.69,而中位数仅为-0.40-0.40,因为少数非常晚的结局拉倒了平均值.

blocks.en: A.6.3 Utterance Statistics
blocks.zh: A.6.3 教育统计

blocks.en: Table 9 reports how often each system speaks and how much it says. The two EgoVoice variants match the instructor’s turn structure closely, at 8.1 and 7.8 words per utterance against 8.3, with a similar share of brief acknowledgements. They still speak about half as often as the instructor. Every baseline takes far longer turns, from 16.6 words for ProAssist to 51.6 for gpt-realtime-2 , and almost never produces a short acknowledgement. This is the turn structure that the Efficiency axis of the LLM judge rewards, and it is also what pushes the baselines past the user’s next action in Table 8 . Counts here are on text-llm , so they are lower than the text-asr counts quoted in Appendix A.2 for MiniCPM-o 4.5.
blocks.zh: 表9报告每个系统的发言频率和内容。 两个EgoVoice变体与教官的转会结构非常相匹配,每句话8.1和7.8个字与8.3个字,同样部分的简短承认。 他们还是像教官一样说一半 每个基线需要更长的转折时间,从ProAssist的16.6个字到gpt-realtime-2的51.6个字,几乎从未产生简短的确认. 这是LLM效率轴判断奖励的转弯结构,这也是推动基线超越表8中用户下一个动作的原因. 这里的计数在文本-llm上,因此低于附录A.2所引用的MiniCPM-o 4.5的文本-asr计数.

blocks.zh: A.6.4 意义测试

EgoVoice-DPO speaks at the same moment as the instructor, says the same thing, and finishes before the user acts. The system prompt lists the task steps in third person, so the model has to choose which step is due, phrase it as an instruction, and time it.
blocks.zh: 图10:两项成功的干预措施。 每个面板遵循图3,在底部加上教员自己的演讲(阴影)并标出用户关联动作的开始. EgoVoice-DPO与教官同时说话,说出同样的话来,在用户行事前完成. 系统即时在第三人称中列出任务步骤,因此模型必须选择哪个步骤是到期的,将其短语为指示,以及时间.

blocks.en: Figure 11: Two interventions that end too late. The onset and the content are right, but the model’s speech runs well past the instructor’s and is still playing when the user begins the action.
blocks.zh: 图11:两项干预措施结束得太晚。 开始时间和内容是正确的,但模型的演讲远远超过导师的演讲,在用户开始行动时仍在播放.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Two interventions that guide the wrong step. The model delivers an instruction that belongs elsewhere in the task: in the first, one the instructor gave 14 seconds earlier; in the second, one the model itself gave 17 seconds earlier. In both cases the instructor has already moved on.
blocks.zh: 图12:指导错误步骤的两项干预措施。 该模型给出了属于任务中其他部分的指令:第一,一个导师提前14秒给出;第二,一个模型本身提前17秒给出. 在这两种情况中,教员已经继续工作。

blocks.en: A.6.5 Qualitative Examples and Failure Modes
blocks.zh: A.6.5 定性实例和失败模式

blocks.en: Figures 10 to 12 show six EgoVoice-DPO interventions in the format of Figure 3 , with two additions: the instructor’s own speech is drawn at the bottom of each panel, so the two waveforms can be compared directly, and the start of the user’s linked action is marked. Figure 10 shows the intended behavior, where the model speaks at the same moment as the instructor, delivers the same instruction, and stops before the user acts.
blocks.zh: 图10至图12以图3的格式显示6个"EgoVoice-DPO"语句,并有2个加法: 教官自己的语句被绘制在每个面板的底部,因此可以直接比较这两个波形,并标出用户链接动作的开始. 图10显示了预期的行为,即模型与导师同时说话,提供相同的指示,并在用户行事前停止.

blocks.en: The two failure modes we measure follow. In Figure 11 the onset and the content are both right, but the model speaks for 5.8 and 4.0 seconds where the instructor took 1.6 and 1.4, so the user is already acting while the assistant is still talking. This is the failure behind the 28.2% late-ending rate. In Figure 12 the model guides the wrong step, delivering an instruction that belongs 14 and 17 seconds earlier in the task. These are the pairs for which a neighbouring reference is closer than the matched one.
blocks.zh: 我们测量的两个失败模式如下。 在图11中,发音和内容都是正确的,但模型讲了5.8和4.0秒,教官用了1.6和1.4,所以在助理还在说话的时候,用户已经在表演了. 这是28.2%的迟发率背后的失败. 在图12中,模型指导错误的步骤,在任务中提前14和17秒提供属于指令. 这些是相邻的参照物比相邻的参照物更接近的对子.

blocks.en: A third failure comes from the backbone rather than from intervention behavior. In 47 of 1,090 utterances the model does not stop, producing degenerate output such as “Or this, this, put it on the table. Put it on the table. Put it on” over 21 seconds. Language switching appears in 13 utterances, including a 373-second Chinese repetition loop. These artifacts are inherited from MiniCPM-o 4.5 and are discussed in the Limitations section.
blocks.zh: 第三个失败来自骨干而不是干预行为. 在1 090个言论中,有47个没有停止,产生诸如“这样就把它放在桌面上”之类的退化产出。 把它放在桌子上。 把它放在桌子上。 穿上它“超过21秒。 语言切换在13个语音中出现,包括373秒的汉语重复循环. 这些文物由MiniCPM-o 4.5所继承,并在"限制"一节中讨论.

blocks.en: A.7 Artifacts and Licenses
blocks.zh: A.7 艺术品和许可证

blocks.en: Table 11 lists all datasets, models, and tools used in this work with their licenses. We use all artifacts for research purposes consistent with their intended use. Our dataset is derived from HoloAssist, which is released under CDLAv2, a permissive license that allows redistribution and derivative works. The original HoloAssist recordings anonymize speaker identities through pitch shifting. Our speech resynthesis replaces all original voices with zero-shot TTS output using unrelated reference speakers from Multilingual LibriSpeech, so no original speaker identity is recoverable from our released data.
blocks.zh: 表11列出了这项工作使用的所有数据集、模型和工具及其许可证。 我们利用所有文物进行符合其预期用途的研究。 我们的数据集来源于HoloAssist,它根据CDLav2发布,这是允许再分配和衍生作品的许可. 最初的"HoloAssist"(HoloAssist)通过投出移位来录制演讲者身份的匿名. 我们的语音再合成用0发TTS输出取代了所有原声,使用来自多语言LibriSpeech的不相干参考语,因此任何原声器身份都无法从我们发布的数据中恢复.

blocks.en: A.8 AI Assistant Usage
blocks.zh: A.8 大赦国际助理使用

blocks.en: We use gpt-5.4-mini for transcript normalization (Section 3.1 ) and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation (Appendix A.4 ), gpt-5.5 for action-linked utterance classification, and gpt-5.6-luna for utterance type classification (Appendix A.4 ). We additionally use an AI assistant for proofreading the manuscript and the human evaluation survey template, for drafting analysis and plotting code, and for generating the initial draft of Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用gpt-5.4-mini进行笔录正常化(第3.1节)和LLM-as-a-judge评价(附录A.4),gpt-5.5进行与行动有关的语句分类,gpt-5.6-luna进行语句类型分类(附录A.4)。 此外,我们还使用人工智能助理来校对手稿和人类评价调查模板,起草分析和绘图守则,以及生成图1的初稿。
